report.title: Underscore character stripped out in memo, replaced with italics
report.body:
### Describe the bug

Existing memos have underscore characters stripped out in a memo and replaced with italics on the adjoining word.

in edit mode the underscores are still there.







### Steps to reproduce

See above

### The version of Memos you're using


v0.25.0

### Screenshots or additional context

_No response_

preconditions: a memo containing underscore characters around or within words exists
plan.reported_actual: In a saved memo, underscore characters are not shown; the adjoining word is rendered in italics instead. In edit mode the underscores are still present.
missing: What exact memo text contains the underscores (e.g. snake_case_word, _word_, or underscores in a URL)?
Are the underscores single or multiple, and are they inside words or at word boundaries?
Exact steps to reproduce; the report only says 'See above'
What is the expected rendering of the text (literal underscores shown, or italics intended)?
assumed: the problem is reproducible with a newly created memo, not only with pre-existing memos
plan.summary: Underscores in saved memo are hidden and adjoining word shown in italics

verdict.headline: The report has no concrete steps to carry out.
